accepts.description: The L1 data-availability fee an OP-stack transaction pays on TOP of its L2 execution gas — usually the larger half of the bill, and the half that every ordinary gas estimator leaves out. Pass data=0x... and get the real L1 fee for THAT transaction; pass bytes=N and get a representative quote. The figure comes from the chain's own GasPriceOracle.getL1Fee (0x420...0F), not from a reimplemented formula — since Fjord the fee depends on FastLZ-compressed size fed through a regression with a 100-byte floor, so hand-rolled arithmetic is wrong today and would drift again at the next fork. l1BaseFee, blobBaseFee and both scalars are returned alongside as context. Reported to six significant figures and per-1000-transactions, because these fees are routinely sub-microdollar and rounding them to cents reports a misleading zero. Base and Optimism only — the endpoint says so explicitly rather than returning a meaningless zero for chains that have no L1 fee. Live public RPC; one paid call.
